text_block_list.name: Driver
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're going to walk the rest of the 
way on foot?! 
I mean, there's no telling when the car 
will start moving again, but...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! We're super strong and fast 
walkers! 
Besides, the manor's just a little further 
ahead—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: It's a race, then!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Ah?! ...I'm not gonna lose to you, Gran--!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ 
...Dia-san, are you not going to chase 
after them?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought I should contact Beauty-san 
first. 
We ought to let her know about the 
situation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, right when it connects, it cuts 
off immediately. 
Ah, again... I wonder why...
(Caw caw caw, screech screech screech...)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, it's getting denser and gloomier... 
That's weird, we should be arriving 
soon...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I see it! There's a huge building 
right there! 
That must be the manor with the chapel! 
Look!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah...! It's huge! It's so huge, 
Dia-san! 
Just like in the photos... it's dreamily 
beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the way the sunlight pours in is 
so holy and gorgeous... 
I wonder if these Three Goddesses have 
watched over countless vows...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's check out the balcony and the 
grand hall too! 
Just this part gives me 100 miles of 
excitement! The rest must be incredible 
too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the balcony is huge too! And so 
stylish! 
Actually, maybe we don't even need to 
clean at all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Choosing this manor was definitely 
the right choice! 
The scenery, the furnishings, everything 
is a perfect ten out of ten... Ah, look, 
look, Gran-san.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Gentil-senpai seems thoroughly 
satisfied too! With this manor!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It truly is a chandelier worthy of a lady, 
after all♪

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ——...H-Hey, guys...?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"What do you all see!?\nWhy are you acting 
like everything's normal!? This place 
is—...!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It's a completely ruined mansion, isn't 
it!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...No way...\nWhat about the chapel...?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No, the chapel was just like this as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
——...It was like this from the very 
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Eek!? Ah... Beauty-san is calling...!!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
『Thank gooooodness, it finally 
connected!\nI couldn't reach any of you 
for the longest time...!!』

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
『...Listen calmly, okay? I did a little 
digging\ninto the mansion you all headed 
to, and I found some strange rumors...』

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
『...They say that place is... a "haunted 
mansion"...』

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A haunted mansion... !?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
『Get out of there right no▲×Е■▽...\nDo 
not shoot or hold a ceremony 
th■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■』

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...It cut off.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"L-Let's get outside! There's no telling 
what'll happen if we stay here!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Ah, it won't open!\nThe door is locked!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"We're trapped...!? I-I-I-It's okay!\nBoo 
is strong, I can break the door open! 
Everything's fine!"

"I   W   O   N   '   T   F   O   R   G   I 
V   E   Y   O   U"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeeeeeek!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Blast-san!?\nThat door over there is 
locked too... ——Kyaah!?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like the door opened.\n...Though 
the hinges seem utterly destroyed, 
however."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And leaving her in such a panicked state 
would be... dangerous, wouldn't it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ——Blast-san, halt.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You must not damage the "shooting 
location's" doors any further.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"S-Shooting location!? What are you 
talking about—!?\nThis place is a haunted 
mansion, you know!?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. There is a mountain of things to 
clean up.\nFrom dust... to unwanted 
intruders."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Which is why we shall proceed with 
'cleaning.'\n——That was the plan from the 
beginning, was it not?"
